raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the correct search result that John, Count Palatine of Neumarkt, was the son of Rupert III of the Palatinate (Rupert, King of the Romans) and erroneously concluded the father-in-law was John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy. This is a factual mix-up between different nobles; the correct father-in-law is Rupert III, not John the Fearless.
